note_for_enricher: Composers transcribed from the contents; verify/correct any obvious errors (e.g. Trumpet Voluntary, Sonata in D Minor attributions) via knowledge/web. 'Music of Many Lands' entries list a tradition rather than a composer — keep composer as printed (e.g. 'Traditional (American folk hymn)').

songs.title: Minuet in G
songs.notes: Actually by Christian Petzold (BWV Anh. 114, Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach); long credited to J.S. Bach as printed here.

songs.title: Prelude No. 2
songs.notes: Likely Prelude No. 2 in C minor from The Well-Tempered Clavier Book I (BWV 847).

songs.title: Two-Part Invention No. 8
songs.notes: Invention No. 8 in F major, BWV 779.

songs.title: Le Petit-Rien
songs.notes: Composer corrected: 'Les Petits Riens' / 'Le Petit Rien' is a harpsichord rondeau by François Couperin (raw listed Boccherini, which is incorrect).

songs.title: Sarabande
songs.notes: Sarabande from the Keyboard Suite in D minor, HWV 437.

songs.title: Trumpet Voluntary
songs.notes: Composer corrected: raw listed Henry Purcell, but the 'Trumpet Voluntary' (Prince of Denmark's March) is by Jeremiah Clarke — a famous long-standing misattribution to Purcell.

songs.title: Sonata in D Minor
songs.notes: Scarlatti attribution verified as correct; he wrote many keyboard sonatas in D minor (this is likely K.1, L.366).

songs.title: Solfeggio
songs.notes: Solfeggietto in C minor, Wq. 117/2 (H. 220).

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.notes: Bagatelle No. 25 in A minor, WoO 59.

songs.title: Moonlight Sonata
songs.notes: First movement (Adagio sostenuto) of Piano Sonata No. 14, Op. 27 No. 2.

songs.title: Gavotte
songs.notes: Gossec's famous Gavotte in D, originally for violin.

songs.title: Lacrimosa
songs.notes: Lacrimosa from Mozart's Requiem in D minor, K. 626.

songs.title: Malagueña
songs.notes: Spanish-flavored salon piece (Albéniz wrote a well-known Malagueña, Op. 165 No. 3).

songs.title: Waltz in A-Flat
songs.notes: Waltz in A-flat major, Op. 39 No. 15.

songs.title: Prelude in E Minor
songs.notes: Prelude Op. 28 No. 4 in E minor.

songs.title: The Minute Waltz
songs.notes: Waltz in D-flat major, Op. 64 No. 1 ('Minute Waltz').

songs.title: Polonaise
songs.notes: Likely the 'Military' Polonaise in A major, Op. 40 No. 1.

songs.title: Pomp and Circumstance
songs.notes: Pomp and Circumstance March No. 1 in D ('Land of Hope and Glory').

songs.title: Liebestraum
songs.notes: Liebestraum No. 3 in A-flat major, S. 541; this favorites edition is a simplified arrangement.

songs.title: Wedding March
songs.notes: Wedding March from incidental music to A Midsummer Night's Dream, Op. 61.

songs.title: Dance of the Clowns
songs.notes: Also known as the 'Dance of the Clowns' / Bergomask from A Midsummer Night's Dream.

songs.title: Serenade
songs.notes: 'Ständchen' (Serenade) from the song cycle Schwanengesang, D. 957.

songs.title: Ave Maria
songs.notes: 'Ellens dritter Gesang', D. 839 ('Ave Maria').

songs.title: The Beautiful Blue Danube
songs.notes: By Johann Strauss II (Op. 314).

songs.title: Piano Concerto No. 1
songs.notes: Opening theme of Piano Concerto No. 1 in B-flat minor, Op. 23; simplified arrangement.

songs.title: Traumerei
songs.notes: 'Träumerei' (No. 7) from Kinderszenen, Op. 15.

songs.title: Clair de Lune
songs.notes: Third movement of Suite bergamasque; this favorites edition is simplified.

songs.title: Humoresque
songs.notes: Humoresque No. 7 in G-flat major, Op. 101.

songs.title: Playera
songs.notes: 'Playera' (Andaluza), Spanish Dance No. 5 from Danzas Españolas.

songs.title: To a Wild Rose
songs.notes: First piece of Woodland Sketches, Op. 51.

songs.title: Narcissus
songs.notes: From Water Scenes, Op. 13.

songs.title: The Swan
songs.notes: 'Le Cygne' from The Carnival of the Animals.

songs.title: Trois Gymnopédies
songs.notes: The three Gymnopédies (1888).

songs.title: Pizzicati
songs.notes: 'Pizzicato' from the ballet Sylvia.

songs.title: Polovtsian Dance
songs.notes: From the opera Prince Igor; the famous theme later became 'Stranger in Paradise'.

songs.title: Anitra's Dance
songs.notes: 'Anitra's Dance' from the Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46.

songs.title: March of the Toys
songs.notes: From the operetta Babes in Toyland.

songs.title: Minuet
songs.notes: Minuet from Don Giovanni, K. 527 ('Don Juan' is the older title used here).

songs.title: Musetta's Waltz
songs.notes: 'Quando m'en vo' (Musetta's Waltz) from La Bohème.

songs.title: Can Can
songs.notes: 'Galop infernal' (Can-Can) from Orphée aux enfers.

songs.title: The Young Prince and the Young Princess
songs.notes: Third movement of Scheherazade, Op. 35.

songs.title: I'm Called Little Buttercup
songs.notes: Gilbert & Sullivan; music by Arthur Sullivan.

songs.title: Waltz of the Flowers
songs.notes: 'Waltz of the Flowers' from The Nutcracker, Op. 71.

songs.title: Grand March
songs.notes: Triumphal March from Aida.

songs.title: Bridal Chorus
songs.notes: 'Treulich geführt' (Bridal Chorus / 'Here Comes the Bride') from Lohengrin.

songs.title: Maple Leaf Rag
songs.notes: Published 1899; ERA snapped to nearest controlled bucket '1900s' (no '1890s' in vocab). Foundational classic rag.

songs.title: Nola
songs.notes: Early novelty piano rag.

songs.title: Bugle Call Rag
songs.notes: Several distinct 'Bugle Call Rag' tunes exist; credited here to Eubie Blake as printed.

songs.title: Kitten on the Keys
songs.notes: Landmark novelty piano rag.

songs.title: Rialto Ripples
songs.notes: Early Gershwin rag, co-written with Will Donaldson.

songs.title: The Banjo
songs.notes: 'The Banjo' (Grotesque Fantasy), Op. 15; a 19th-century concert piece, predates ragtime proper.

songs.title: Solace
songs.notes: Subtitled 'A Mexican Serenade'; habanera-tinged slow rag.

songs.title: Jelly Roll Blues
songs.notes: Often cited as one of the first published jazz compositions.

songs.title: The Whistler and His Dog
songs.notes: Novelty march/caprice; treated as Golden Hits section per book layout.

songs.title: The Stars and Stripes Forever
songs.notes: Composed 1896; ERA snapped to nearest controlled bucket '1900s' (no '1890s' in vocab). U.S. national march.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional). Tune 'New Britain'; words by John Newton (1779).

songs.title: El Choclo
songs.notes: Composer expanded: raw 'Á. G. Villoldo' = Ángel Gregorio Villoldo; foundational Argentine tango (1903).

songs.title: Country Gardens
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); famously arranged by Percy Grainger (1918).

songs.title: Greensleeves (What Child Is This)
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional). Tune also sung as the carol 'What Child Is This'.

songs.title: Santa Lucia
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); the published Neapolitan barcarolle was transcribed by Teodoro Cottrau (1849).

songs.title: Havah Nagilah
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); melody is a Hasidic nigun, lyrics set ca. 1918.

songs.title: Danny Boy (Londonderry Air)
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); 'Londonderry Air' tune, lyrics by Frederic Weatherly (1913).

songs.title: Mexican Hat Dance
songs.notes: Composer corrected: raw listed Felipe A. Partichela, who was the 1919 arranger. The Jarabe Tapatío was composed by Jesús González Rubio (19th c.).

songs.title: Dark Eyes
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); 'Ochi Chyornye' — lyrics by Yevhen Hrebinka, set to a Florian Hermann melody.

songs.title: Finlandia
songs.notes: The 'Finlandia Hymn' theme from the tone poem, Op. 26.

songs.title: Auld Lang Syne
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); words set by Robert Burns (1788).

songs.title: Carnival of Venice
songs.notes: Composer kept as printed (traditional); 'O mamma mia' tune, popularized in variation sets by Paganini and others.

songs.title: I Love a Piano
songs.notes: Introduced in the revue Stop! Look! Listen!

songs.title: A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody
songs.notes: Signature theme of the Ziegfeld Follies.

songs.title: My Melancholy Baby
songs.notes: Music by Ernie Burnett (verified), lyrics by George A. Norton.

songs.title: Give My Regards to Broadway
songs.notes: From the musical Little Johnny Jones.

songs.title: After You've Gone
songs.notes: Writing credit kept as printed; music by Turner Layton, lyrics by Henry Creamer.

songs.title: St. Louis Blues
songs.notes: 'Father of the Blues' W.C. Handy's signature composition.

songs.title: Look for the Silver Lining
songs.notes: Music by Jerome Kern, lyrics by B.G. DeSylva; from the musical Sally.

songs.title: Pretty Baby
songs.notes: Music by Egbert Van Alstyne and Tony Jackson, lyrics by Gus Kahn.

songs.title: I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles
songs.notes: Writing credit kept as printed ('Jaan Kenbrovin' was a pseudonym for the lyric trio).

songs.title: You Made Me Love You
songs.notes: Music by James V. Monaco, lyrics by Joseph McCarthy.

songs.title: Shine On Harvest Moon
songs.notes: Writing credit kept as printed; introduced in the Ziegfeld Follies of 1908.

songs.title: Dallas Blues
songs.notes: Often cited as the first published 12-bar blues (1912).

songs.title: Moonlight Bay
songs.notes: Music by Percy Wenrich, lyrics by Edward Madden.

songs.title: In the Shade of the Old Apple Tree
songs.notes: Music by Egbert Van Alstyne, lyrics by Harry Williams.
